game_text: Deploy -3 if Death Star II on table. May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 2. Power and forfeit + 1 for each Rebel starship here. [Ship-docking]
